item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israel is closing all West Bank land crossings on election day while expanding raids in Hebron that have forced thousands from their homes and led the IDF to forcibly remove 2,231 Palestinians from the city. Israeli airstrikes have hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, and a university campus in Gaza, killing three people, while separate strikes killed eight civilians including a child. The IDF is also targeting Hamas financing networks, reporting the killing of two terror operatives involved in funding the group. Visually and hearing-impaired children in Gaza are missing school because of the war. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
